profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-based public company, traded as HSAI, that describes itself on its website as a global leader in 3D perception and in lidar solutions for ADAS and autonomous mobility. The company says its lidar sensors serve ADAS, autonomous vehicles, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications, and that it partners with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle, and robotics companies worldwide, with mass-produced lidars delivered to customers in over 40 countries. It describes lidar as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, providing high-resolution 3D perception that enables features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot), and says its sensors meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving used by robotaxis and robobuses.

The company's own framing places it in physical AI and spatial intelligence as well as automotive sensing, with an emphasis on reliability and safety for ADAS and autonomous fleets. Its SEC filing record lists CIK 0001861737. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
